breakdown.description: `solidDisplacementFoam` models solid deformation and cannot capture the free-surface flow and topology changes of a fluid dam break. A multiphase fluid solver like `interFoam` is required.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not address the solver choice at all. It is merely a clarifying question about mesh resolution and makes no mention of correcting `solidDisplacementFoam` to `interFoam`. The inconsistency is entirely unresolved.
